text_block_list.text: One day, shortly before the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: All right, we're here!
choice_data_list: It's so quiet and the air is so clear...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
There's seriously nothing out there~
It's completely cut off from the hustle and bustle of the city.
Well, the frogs get pretty noisy at night though!

"...Katsuragi Ace and I had arrived in her hometown.
The reason things turned out this way goes back a little bit—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Stop training for now and rest...!? What do you mean by that...!?
choice_data_list: At this rate, you'll just end up getting anxious for nothing.
At this rate, you'll just end up getting anxious for nothing, you know.

text_block_list.text: First, as a premise, Katsuragi Ace's body and mind right now are sufficiently conditioned to compete in the Japan Cup.

"While our strategy for certain victory is yet undecided,
I have determined that blindly training in search of one offers
little benefit and carries significant risk."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "...Basically, rushing might lead to an injury, so you'd rather change things up entirely?"

I nod in agreement. Besides, resting up and ensuring
she's in top physical and mental condition for the big day
should also be crucial to boosting our chances of winning.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
……Understood!
If you say so, Trainer, I'll switch gears!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Well, to be blunt, I felt like I was stuck in a rut too,
and I was thinking, "This is bad"...
And so, Katsuragi Ace and I suddenly decided to take a day off—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Still, it totally freaked me out when Mom went and contacted you behind my back, Trainer!
Like, "Why are you calling them of all people?!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Because if I told you to 'go home and visit once in a while,' you'd definitely refuse! So I figured it was worth a shot anyway!"
choice_data_list: We're really grateful on our end as well.

text_block_list.text:
If Katsuragi Ace needed to rest, I thought going back home would be best,
so her calling to consult me about it the other day was a godsend.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the Japan Cup, huh...
You've really made it to an unbelievable stage!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Whenever we all watch you on TV, you know,
it just feels so surreal.
Like, 'Whoa, the world on the other side of the TV is actually real~'.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace's Father
text_block_list.text:
"You know, there are lots of kids in the neighborhood lately
who look up to you.
Saying things like, 'I'm gonna run in races someday too.'"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I'd be super happy about that—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Mmh~~!
No matter when I visit, this place never changes!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yep. That's where I used to run every day until I collapsed back when I was a kid.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"It feels great whenever I run.
How do I put it... it's like I can totally immerse myself...
Like everything else just fades away—"
choice_data_list: ...Why don't you go for a quick run?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?
...To tell the truth, I was kind of itching to try it!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heh—!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaaahhh!!!
This really is the beeeeeeest!!!

"Katsuragi Ace runs while shouting joyfully.
Dashing ever forward, ever further, she seemed to
keep accelerating without ever stopping—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ooooohh!!!!
Not yet, not yet, not yet, not yetttt!!!!!

Perhaps because it was under completely unrestricted conditions, unlike a race or training.
That run was something unknown even to herself.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Sorry, Trainer!
It's been a while, so I got a little too excited!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Man, seriously, that was a close one.
I almost kept running until I collapsed and forgot to head back."
choice_data_list: —I have a proposal regarding the Japan Cup.
—Let me make a proposal regarding the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A proposal—
Did you come up with some kind of plan?!

I nod in agreement, and then
explain my thoughts as concisely as possible.
choice_data_list: In the race, just look straight ahead and run.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Look... ahead...?
choice_data_list: Just run without worrying about Rudolf or Mr. C.B.
Just run without worrying about Rudolf or Mr. C.B., okay?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure that's fine?!
Shouldn't you be paying attention to those guys behind—
choice_data_list: That's not very ace-like at all.
That's not very ace-like of you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: True to myself...?
Everyone who cheers for Katsuragi Ace, myself included, is drawn to her way of life—fighting on relentlessly, never backing down before any wall or adversity.
And that was just as true when it came to running—

Her running style—leading the pack as if carving through hardships,
powerfully driving forward—also gave people courage.

Her way of life, her running, inspiring all who watch
and carrying their hopes forward.
That is the very essence of Katsuragi Ace—
In turn, it made me realize once again that Katsuragi Ace is at her strongest when she's fighting with her eyes fixed solely on what's ahead.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ――When fighting while looking only "forward"...
choice_data_list: Don't "run away" just because you're worried about what's "behind" you.

text_block_list.text:
A rival in pursuit. If she worries about Symboli Rudolf
or Mr. C.B., her running will only shrink
and lose its momentum.

Simply driving "forward" as fast as possible.
Running with nothing in mind except reaching the finish line.
Even if these legs feel like they're about to give out—

If it's Katsuragi Ace, she can turn all the hopes
entrusted to her into strength and push forward. No, that's what she's always done.

That is the strongest strategy
Katsuragi Ace can currently execute—
choice_data_list: That's an "ace" run only you could pull off!
That's an "ace's" run that only you can pull off!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ………………So that's how an "Ace" runs, huh.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...I ran all the way here from nothing in the first place.
If I'm gonna bet on anything, it has to be the words of the person I trust most...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'll give it a shot, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
In the Japan Cup,
I'll keep moving forward, looking only ahead...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And I'll cross that finish line faster than anyone and win!!
—With the running of an "ace"!!
—The fire dwelling in Katsuragi Ace's eyes as she declared this burned stronger and hotter than ever before.
—And then came the day of the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm getting nervous~!
It's a super huge stage, and the rivals are super-duper crazy!
I hope S-cchi's gonna be okay~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. I'm sure she'll run with all her strength.
I mean, hasn't she always done so up until now?"

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she will definitely pull through.
As an "ace"—
(WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Calm and composed as ever. Impressive.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, you're quite rare. You can barely hide your fierce ambition.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It just goes to show how formidable the Umamusume here are, including yourself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...!?
What is this presence—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Haha! That's amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"It seems I was still underestimating you.
So this... is your true form...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(To everyone who cheers for me.
I'll turn all of your feelings into strength—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... fight alongside me.
I'll blaze the trail...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm Katsuragi Ace!
Today, I'm gonna push forward faster than anyone else—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: It's the "Ace"!!!!!!
